_why: @redrob-labs/ui deliberately ships no logo file: its Mark component takes src and darkSrc, so the
host supplies the artwork. There is no version to resolve, so these are pinned by sha256 and by
their path in the design system delivery.
What the hash is FOR. 10-logo.md: the artwork is 'Never redrawn, restretched, recolored or
otherwise modified', and lists recoloring, substituting the gradient and adding an effect under
Incorrect usage. A brand file is the one asset here that a well-meaning edit ruins silently: nudge
the blue, flatten the gradient, re-export smaller, and every gate still passes because no build
reads a PNG's pixels. The hash is what fails.
This repo shipped src/assets/redrob-mark-512.png, whose sha256 matched none of the five symbol
variants in the delivery and which carried no alpha channel -- a hand-made approximation. It is
deleted; both canonical grounds are vendored here instead.
20-color.md closes the product spectrum at seven and states there is no eighth product colour.
10-logo.md's way out is that a new product ships as a feature of the product whose band it fits.
Query is a developer tool over a database, which is Code's band.
